newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: S.P. Setia plans 170 mln rgt bond issue.
newsitem.headline: S.P. Setia plans 170 mln rgt bond issue.

text.p: Malaysian civil engineering and infrastructure firm S.P. Setia Bhd has proposed to issue 170 million ringgit in five-year bonds with detachable warrants, the national Bernama news agency said on Tuesday.
Setia will issue the three percent redeemable bank guaranteed unsecured 1997/2002 bonds, with up to 30.31 million warrants on a "bought deal" basis.

It said 167.5 million ringgit from the total proceeds will be used to part finance a joint venture project with Putrajaya Holdings Sdn Bhd to develop part of the new federal administrative capital of Putrajaya located outside Kuala Lumpur.
The project comprises the development of residential and commercial properties, construction of the Prime Minister's office and residence, and various government offices.
